description: This file contains a partial class implementation of `AdoNetGrainDirectory` which is an internal sealed class implementing the `IGrainDirectory` interface. It manages grain activation lookups, registration, unregistration, and silo-based unregistrations using an ADO.NET database backend with asynchronous database queries and detailed logging.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectory
classes.description: A class responsible for managing grain directory entries via ADO.NET, supporting lookup, registration, and removal of grain addresses with concurrency control and logging.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously looks up a grain activation address by its GrainId.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a new grain activation address and returns the stored address.

methods.name: UnregisterSilos
methods.description: Unregisters all grain activations associated with specified silo addresses.

methods.name: GetQueriesAsync
methods.description: Ensures the database queries object is loaded asynchronously, with concurrency control.
